tagline: Leading multicultural regional bank in the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Interest Margin is the primary driver of the bank's revenues, reflecting its ability to efficiently manage the spread between interest income on assets and interest expenses on liabilities.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income generated by assets and interest expenses paid on liabilities.
kpis.description: Indicates the profitability of the bank's principal lending and investment activity.
kpis.signal: Improvement in Net Interest Margin, a sign of efficient interest rate management.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after taxes for the fiscal period.
kpis.description: Measures the overall profitability of the company.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in net income, impacted by exceptional items and merger charges.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Indicates the size and scope of the company's operations.
kpis.signal: Growth in assets, supported by the acquisition of Territorial Bancorp in April 2025.

kpis.name: Customer Deposits
kpis.description: Primary source of funding for lending activities.
kpis.signal: Increase in deposits, reflecting customer confidence and organic and inorganic growth.

kpis.short: Allowance for credit losses to loans receivable
kpis.name: Allowance for credit losses to loans receivable
kpis.explanation: Ratio of allowance for credit losses to total loans receivable.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease in the allowance ratio, suggesting improvement in loan portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses divided by net interest income and non-interest income.
kpis.description: Measures the bank's operational efficiency (lower is better).
kpis.signal: Increase in efficiency ratio, indicating lower operational efficiency, impacted by merger charges and integration fees.

kpis.name: Return on Average Stockholders Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average shareholders' equity.
kpis.signal: Significant decrease in return on equity, impacted by lower net income related to merger charges.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $0.49 in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net income, excluding notable items
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted to exclude exceptional or non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Provides a clearer view of underlying operational performance, excluding merger charges.
kpis.signal: Growth in adjusted net income, indicating solid underlying operational performance.

kpis.name: Diluted earnings per share, excluding notable items
kpis.explanation: Diluted earnings per share adjusted to exclude exceptional items.
kpis.description: Measures profitability per share, excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.signal: Increase in adjusted diluted earnings per share, a sign of improvement in underlying profitability per share.

kpis.short: Tangible common equity ( TCE ) per share
kpis.name: Tangible common equity per share
kpis.explanation: Value of tangible net assets attributable to each outstanding common share.
kpis.description: Indicator of the company's intrinsic value per share.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in tangible common equity per share, reflecting the impact of post-acquisition accounting adjustments.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded an increase in non-performing loans, with a non-performing loans to loans receivable ratio of 0.90% in 2025, compared to 0.67% in 2024. This indicates increased credit risk related to post-acquisition portfolio growth.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rates are sensitive to numerous factors beyond the company's control, such as changes in the national economy and Federal Reserve monetary policies. Asset yield declined from 5.69% to 5.50%, while the cost of liabilities remained elevated at 3.81%.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive banking market, with numerous players offering similar services. The increase in efficiency ratio to 78.13% reflects increased competitive pressure.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the banking sector, which may impact its operations and results. The company's capital ratios remain above minimum regulatory thresholds.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains adequate liquidity levels with a deposits to assets ratio of 84.2% and diversified funding sources. The liquidity ratio improved compared to prior years.

risks.title: Merger and Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Territorial Bancorp in April 2025 creates significant operational and technology integration risks. The efficiency ratio increased significantly and net income declined 38.2% in 2025 due to merger charges.

ai_positioning.summary: Hope Bancorp does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on the company's financial aspects and operations without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
